column2: Response TA returns the activity status of ME. +CPAS: <pas> OK If error is related to ME functionality: +CME ERROR: <err>

Parameter <pas> 0 Ready (MT allows commands from TA/TE) 2 Unknown (MT is not guaranteed to respond to tructions) 3 Ringing (MT is ready for commands from TA/TE, but the ringer is active) 4 Call in progress (MT is ready for commands from TA/TE, a call is in progress)
